sections.content: Look at the time expression and the context before choosing a tense. A period that is still open often favours the pretérito perfecto: Este año he aprendido mucho. A finished period or clearly completed event favours the indefinido: El año pasado aprendí mucho. Familiar A2 connectors such as ya, todavía, porque and por eso can also appear with either tense when the context permits.

items.english: I have improved a lot this year.
I improved a lot last year.
I have already finished the course.

items.spanish: Terminé el curso porque quise descansar.
items.english: I finished the course because I wanted to rest.

sections.content: Check the time frame before choosing the tense. A period connected to the present often uses the pretérito perfecto; a finished past period or completed event often uses the indefinido.
